name: walk_turn_walk
title: Walk -> 90 deg footwork turn -> walk (new heading)
summary: The G1 walks ~5 m on +x, turns a REAL ~90 deg by footwork (BATON solo-turn, crane yaw auto-OFF => wtz=0), then walks a clean straight leg along +y. TURN-LOOP replays partial passes of the modular 15-deg step-turn ghost (restart plateau planned from the measured ~0.67 live yaw gain) until the ACTUAL heading reaches TURN_TO_DEG, always finishing through the ghost's end-hold (never a mid-lut arrest). TURN_HOLD_LOCK=0 drops the completed-turn xy clamp (OOD for the feet-together turner -- it wound the settled hold into a spin+fall). keep-heading pins leg 2 to the achieved settled yaw; HARNESS_FY_HEADING keeps the crane brake in the heading frame. Measured 3/3: turn 90.6-95.6 deg actual, leg 2 bearing 82-90 deg, 0 falls (landing quantum = the ghost's 15-deg mini-pivot).
_turn_note: seq.env overrides the turn_in_place defaults: this demo runs the 90-deg turner (wr_turn90 + ghost_turn_90) under TURN-LOOP (loop-until-actual-90, TURN_HOLD_LOCK=0) exactly as run_walk_turn_walk.sh does; turn_solo keeps the skill defaults (wr_stepturn/180). BATON_COLD_HIDDEN='' unsets the derived cold-handover knob: the verified script runs the warm handover.

verification.support: G1 lambda=0.9 weight-bearing balance harness; zero yaw torque; not free-standing
verification.result: 3/3 headless: leg 1 clean 5.2 m +x; TURN-LOOP lands the footwork turn at 90.6-95.6 deg actual (2-3 passes, measured gain 0.67-0.73), settled end-hold, keep-heading 84-90 deg; leg 2 straight at 82-90 deg bearing (best: x drift 0.3 m over 6.4 m +y); min z 0.662+, 0 falls
